facts.text: Under National Louis University's Accelerate U program, students eligible for full Pell and MAP aid pay $0 out of pocket while earning up to 30 college credits toward a degree.

sources.title: Accelerate U | National Louis University | Chicago, Illinois | Tampa ...
sources.quote: Learners who are eligible for full Pell (federal financial aid) & MAP (Illinois financial aid) will pay $0 out of pocket.

sources.title: Accelerate U | National Louis University | Chicago, Illinois | Tampa ...
sources.quote: Each training pathway comes with up to 30 college credits that will apply in full towards a National Louis University degree.
